example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি খাটো গলায় তার রহস্যের কথা বললেন।
দুজন বন্ধু খাটো গলায় গোপন আলোচনা করছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He spoke in a low voice about his secret.
The two friends were discussing in hushed tones.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to indicate speaking softly or confidentially.
